mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_tb (student_id, student_name, birth, school, address, address_detail, gender, entry_han_date, entry_book_date, created_at, grade_no, level_no, status_no, student_privacy_agree) values (#{studentId}, #{studentName}, #{birth}, #{school}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{gender}, #{entryHanDate}, #{entryBookDate}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{gradeNo}, #{levelNo}, #{statusNo}, #{studentPrivacyAgree});
mapper.select:
WITH latest_history AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY student_no ORDER BY COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC ) AS rn FROM STATUS_HISTORY ) SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school AS school, grade.grade AS grade, l.level AS level, s.gender AS gender, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, s.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, s.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate, s.created_at AS createdAt,
MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '1' THEN class.class_name END) AS hanClass, MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '2' THEN class.class_name END) AS bookClass,
CASE WHEN p.parent_tel_first IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_middle IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.parent_tel_first + '-' + p.parent_tel_middle + '-' + p.parent_tel_last END AS parentTel,
h.status_no AS status, h.reason,
-- 형제 여부 CASE WHEN COUNT(sb2.student_no) > 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS isSibling
FROM STUDENT_TB s
LEFT JOIN sibling sb ON sb.student_no = s.student_no LEFT JOIN sibling sb2 ON sb.sibling_code = sb2.sibling_code
LEFT JOIN latest_history h ON s.student_no = h.student_no AND h.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN GRADE_CODE grade ON s.grade_no = grade.grade_no LEFT JOIN LEVEL_CODE l ON s.level_no = l.level_no LEFT JOIN CENTER_TB c ON s.center_no = c.center_no
LEFT JOIN STUDENT_CLASS stu_class ON s.student_no = stu_class.student_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_INSTANCE ci ON ci.class_instance_no = stu_class.class_instance_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_CODE class ON class.class_no = ci.class_no
-- 부모 정보 LEFT JOIN PARENT p ON p.student_no = s.student_no
GROUP BY s.student_no, s.student_name, s.school, grade.grade, l.level, s.gender, s.birth, s.address, s.address_detail, c.center_name, s.entry_han_date, s.entry_book_date, s.created_at, h.status_no, h.reason, p.parent_tel_first, p.parent_tel_middle, p.parent_tel_last, sb.sibling_code;

WITH latest_history AS ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY student_no ORDER BY COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC ) AS rn FROM STATUS_HISTORY ) SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.student_name AS studentName, s.school AS school, grade.grade AS grade, l.level AS level, s.gender AS gender, s.birth AS birth, s.address AS address, s.address_detail AS addressDetail, c.center_name AS center, s.entry_han_date AS entryHanDate, s.entry_book_date AS entryBookDate, s.created_at AS createdAt,
MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '1' THEN class.class_name END) AS hanClass, MAX(CASE WHEN class.class_type = '2' THEN class.class_name END) AS bookClass,
CASE WHEN p.parent_tel_first IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_middle IS NULL OR p.parent_tel_last IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.parent_tel_first + '-' + p.parent_tel_middle + '-' + p.parent_tel_last END AS parentTel,
h.status_no as status, h.reason
FROM STUDENT_TB s
LEFT JOIN latest_history h ON s.student_no = h.student_no AND h.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN GRADE_CODE grade ON s.grade_no = grade.grade_no LEFT JOIN LEVEL_CODE l ON s.level_no = l.level_no LEFT JOIN CENTER_TB c ON s.center_no = c.center_no
LEFT JOIN STUDENT_CLASS stu_class ON s.student_no = stu_class.student_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_INSTANCE ci ON ci.class_instance_no = stu_class.class_instance_no LEFT JOIN CLASS_CODE class ON class.class_no = ci.class_no
LEFT JOIN PARENT p ON p.student_no = s.student_no
WHERE s.student_no = #{studentId}
GROUP BY s.student_no, s.student_name, s.school, grade.grade, l.level, s.gender, s.birth, s.address, s.address_detail, c.center_name, s.entry_han_date, s.entry_book_date, s.created_at, h.status_no, h.reason

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.student_name as studentName, g.grade as grade, MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '1' THEN cc.class_name END) AS hanClass, MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '2' THEN cc.class_name END) AS bookClass, MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '1' THEN u.username END) AS hanTeacher, MAX(CASE WHEN cc.class_type = '2' THEN u.username END) AS bookTeacher, s.created_at as createdAt, sth.move_at as moveAt FROM student_tb s LEFT JOIN grade_code g ON s.grade_no = g.grade_no LEFT JOIN student_class sc ON s.student_no = sc.student_no LEFT JOIN class_instance ci ON sc.class_instance_no = ci.class_instance_no LEFT JOIN class_code cc ON ci.class_no = cc.class_no LEFT JOIN user_tb u ON u.user_no = ci.user_no LEFT JOIN student_transfer_history sth ON sth.student_no = s.student_no GROUP BY s.student_name ORDER BY s.student_no
